newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia dlr, bonds seesaw on RBA Bulletin.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia dlr, bonds seesaw on RBA Bulletin.

text.p: The Australian dollar and bonds seesawed after the Reserve Bank of Australia said low inflationary expectations would support the rate cut case.
In its quarterly Bulletin the central bank also said that if the economy is weaker than expected, this would also strengthen the case for easier monetary policy.

The local dollar weakened to around US$0.7884 from US$0.7895/0.7900 before edging back to US$0.7890/95, while the December 10-year bond futures contract rose to 92.430 from a pre-Bulletin 92.395 before retreating to 92.380.

Likewise, December bill futures, which are already discounting a 50 basis point rate reduction in current 7.0 percent official interest rates, rose initially to 93.53 on the RBA release from 93.47, before slipping back to 93.44.
